title: CNN-Transformer with Sigmoid Label for High-Resolution Sub-Degree DOA Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2610.13433v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper addresses the grid quantization error of deep-learning (DL)-based direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation. Classification- based DOA methods discretize the continuous angular space into a grid, so that with a peak-based read-out, the accuracy and resolution are limited by the grid step and by the width of the label peak. To address this issue, we propose a sigmoid label that encodes the sources' DOAs as the sum of angle-shifted monotonic sigmoid functions. Differentiating the output of a CNN-Transformer network trained with the sigmoid label produces sharp spectral peaks at the source DOAs. Combined with a moderately refined grid step of 0.25 degrees, the CNN-Transformer with the proposed sigmoid label attains sub-degree accuracy and a 1-degree resolution, breaking the limit of the grid quantization error. translated_title: 采用Sigmoid标签的CNN-Transformer实现高分辨率亚度级波达方向（DOA）估计
translated_abstract: 本文针对基于深度学习的波达方向（DOA）估计中的网格量化误差问题展开研究。基于分类的DOA方法将连续角度空间离散化为网格，因此采用基于峰值的读出方式时，精度和分辨率受到网格步长和标签峰值宽度的限制。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种sigmoid标签，将信源的DOA编码为角度偏移的单调sigmoid函数之和。对使用sigmoid标签训练的CNN-Transformer网络的输出进行求导，可在信源DOA处产生尖锐的谱峰。结合适度细化的0.25度网格步长，采用所提出sigmoid标签的CNN-Transformer实现了亚度级精度和1度分辨率，突破了网格量化误差的限制。在统一的CNN-Transformer骨干网络下，我们将所提出的Sigmoid标签与高斯标签、0-1硬标……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出将信源DOA编码为角度偏移单调sigmoid函数之和的sigmoid标签，配合CNN-Transformer网络和0.25度网格步长，实现了亚度级精度和1度分辨率，突破了基于分类的DOA估计的网格量化误差限制。
en_tdlr: A sigmoid label encoding sources' DOAs as the sum of angle-shifted monotonic sigmoid functions, combined with a CNN-Transformer network and a 0.25-degree grid step, achieves sub-degree accuracy and 1-degree resolution, breaking through the grid quantization error limit of classification-based DOA estimation.
